og.title: Laboratory Test Calculator - Nursing Calculators
og.description: Evaluate lab test results with reference values and automatic interpretation.

lead: Enter the values of laboratory exams and compare them with reference values.

secoes.corpo:
Enter how many exams you performed to calculate the average reading time

Educational Notice: This calculator is educational. It checks whether exam values are within reference ranges and has no diagnostic intent . Diagnosis of pathologies and clinical evaluation along with laboratory findings is exclusive to physicians. Nursing professionals must have knowledge of laboratory exam alterations to assist in the development of the Nursing Care Systematization (SAE) and perform laboratory surveillance to trigger protocols, Rapid Response Team (Code Yellow), and effective communication with the medical team in case of alterations.
